profile.name: Haja Shafrith Suhail
profile.title: Senior Software Engineer
profile.tagline: Frontends that scale. Agents that deliver.
profile.summary:
I build AI solutions for real business problems: support assistants that answer from a company's own documents, multi-agent systems that split work across specialised agents, and n8n automations that remove repetitive manual steps. I work with RAG, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen and the OpenAI API, and ship them as usable apps with FastAPI, Streamlit and Docker.

Behind that is 7+ years of production software engineering, including 4+ years as an Angular developer on an enterprise platform at Anteriad, so the AI I build comes with interfaces people can actually use.
